Valkyrie · Software · Immersive / 2020

Virtual Classroom

Multi-platform multi-user virtual classroom. Supports PC VR headsets and desktop. Includes audio track, white board and post-it notes, shared virtual worlds and objects, teacher and student modes. Created in Unity3D & PUN in 2020. Supported by Innovate UK.
